editorial:
Imagine you are visiting a quiet, old monastery in the north where a friendly guide named Tatyana spends her days. Things get messy when two old classmates, both named Ivan, show up and start fighting for her heart. One is a med student and the other is a rich businessman. It starts as a classic love triangle, but then it takes a wild turn when a balloon accident puts Tatyana in a deep coma. You will find yourself rooting for the med student, Ivan Voronov, who believes he is the only one who can wake her up using a very risky and intimate method.

What makes this story pop is the sheer drama and the shock of seeing a romantic story turn into a legal nightmare. The acting is solid, though the pacing feels a bit like an old-school soap opera. You might find some of the plot twists a bit over the top, but that is part of the charm. If you enjoy heavy romance with a side of mystery, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: After being arrested and labeled a maniac, Ivan manages to prove that his actions were actually meant to save Tatyana. The truth comes out that his connection to her was the only thing keeping her alive. Tatyana finally wakes up from her coma, realizing who truly loved her. The rivalry between the two Ivans ends with the med student winning her heart, and they get a happy ending despite the police drama.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic dramas with big twists.
